msc_ownership_note: Primary 81Q35 concerns quantum mechanics on graphs with wave scattering; Ingremeau arXiv:2012.08369 is an independently verified quantum-graph scattering source with 81Q35 among its primary MSC codes. Mugnolo–Pivovarchik instead lists primary 34B45; its secondary 81Q35 is not asserted to be primary.
public_date_evidence: Earliest publicly verifiable version of the motivating source arXiv:2211.05465 was posted on 2022-11-10; contextual older sources do not determine its first public date.
scientific_integrity: Exact proof and separate finite exact checks; no independent validation and no priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Standard Kirchhoff free metric graphs with common edge length only; distinct lead vertices; generic positive energies only. Sets of attainable port responses, not arbitrary placements, are compared. Novelty remains contingent on completeness of indexed literature.
title: Four-port scattering threshold for the equilateral Shrikhande–rook quantum-graph pair
